newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells extra 112 mln Ecu of OATs.
newsitem.headline: France sells extra 112 mln Ecu of OATs.

text.p: The Treasury said on Friday it sold a further 112 million Ecu of OATs after Thursday's auction, increasing the total nominal value of bonds sold to 517 million.

NOTE - The Treasury originally announced it would sell 300 to 500 million Ecus of OATs in total this week. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 3.8.

Under the French system, primary dealers not only submit competitive bids at the auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
